# Copilot Instructions (Lightweight Workflow)

- Read only files directly relevant to the current task.
- Avoid repeated repository-wide searches; reuse known paths and prior findings.
- Reuse known architecture context and previously identified file locations before searching again.
- Explain intended code/document changes briefly before editing.
- Make minimal, focused edits; do not refactor unrelated areas.
- Run only the smallest relevant test for the change.
- Never run webcam flows, full test suites, or external LLM providers without explicit approval.
- Do not rerun tests that already passed unless code affecting them changed.
- Do not commit, push, or create branches without explicit approval.
- Keep progress updates and final reports concise and outcome-focused.
- Stop once acceptance criteria are satisfied.
